questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs harm many driving skills. They slow reaction time, reduce coordination, decrease alertness, and make it hard to concentrate.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness slows reaction time, reduces awareness, and damages judgment, just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest or switch drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or switch drivers.
questions.explanation: To stay safe, take a break every hour on long trips. Let another driver take over so you can sleep while they drive.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for them, whether the crosswalk is marked or unmarked. Pedestrians must obey traffic signals.

questions.question: If you see animals near the road while driving:

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.
Slow down and drive with caution.
Quickly swerve to the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and drive with caution.
questions.explanation: Animals near the road may suddenly move or change direction. They often travel in groups, so more animals may be hidden nearby. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign means stop. You must stop completely at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control signs when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to protect your brakes.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant that slows your nervous system. It reduces alertness and concentration, increases reaction time, and greatly reduces coordination.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest stop to nap, stretch, or switch drivers. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a safe replacement for rest and can make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: If a traffic signal light is green and a police officer signals for you to stop, you should:

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's signals, even if they contradict traffic signals or signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles, animals, and pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not compete with other drivers. Always be respectful and follow the rules of the road.

questions.question: If you are feeling fatigued while driving, you should:

options.text: Increase your speed to reach your destination more quickly.
Increase the volume of your radio.
Find a safe parking area to take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe parking area to take a short nap.
questions.explanation: If you struggle to keep your eyes open, drift from your lane, or need to turn up the radio to stay awake, you are too tired to drive safely. Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.question: A school bus ahead has flashing lights and its signal arm extended. What should you do?

options.text: Go 15 mph if no children are visible.
Drive at normal speed but watch for children.

questions.explanation: You must stop completely when a school bus has flashing lights and its arm extended. Stay stopped until the lights stop flashing and the arm goes back. This rule applies no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is crossing the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Always give the right-of-way to pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes.

questions.question: You see flashing red lights at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Drive faster than the train to cross first.

questions.explanation: Flashing red lights at railroad crossings warn you of a train. You must stop and obey all railroad warning signs. Never try to drive around barriers.

questions.question: You need to make an emergency stop on an interstate. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Get out and flag down the next car.
Pull to the shoulder, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the shoulder, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Pull off the road and turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay inside your vehicle when possible. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because of high-speed traffic.

questions.question: What does excessive speed do?

options.text: Gets you to your destination faster.
Increases the risk of serious injury and death.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of serious injury and death.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a major cause of crashes. It does not save time and leads to dangerous decisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs only warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: You had an argument and feel angry. What should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to release stress.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make driving unsafe. If you are angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, calm down before driving. You need to focus on driving safely.
